🎓 Application Phases

1
Application Submitted
Student submits application with required documents and personal statement
2
Interview & Assessment
School reviews application and conducts interview or entrance assessment
3
Offering
School sends deposit form, student pays and uploads proof, school confirms
4
Admission Documents
Collect official documents, references, medical forms, and agreements
5
Pre-Departure
CAS letter issued, visa application, and travel arrangements
